questions.question: Define a business plan and give four reasons why an entrepreneur needs one.
questions.expected_answer: A business plan is a written document that describes a business idea and how the entrepreneur will make it succeed, covering the product, market, operations, management and finances. Reasons: to think through the idea before risking money; to obtain finance from banks or investors; to set goals and measure progress; to communicate the business to partners, staff and suppliers.

questions.question: List the components of a business plan in order.
questions.expected_answer: Cover page and table of contents; executive summary; description of the business (vision, mission, goals, legal form, location, owner); description of the product or service; market analysis including SWOT; marketing plan; production or operations plan; management plan; financial plan; appendices.

questions.question: Distinguish between a vision, a mission and a goal, and rewrite 'wash many cars' as a SMART goal.
questions.expected_answer: Vision: the long-term picture of what the business wants to become. Mission: what the business does now, for whom and how. Goal: a specific target to be reached by a certain time. SMART version: wash 120 cars per month by the end of the sixth month of trading.
